defs.def: to get money as profit or interest on money you lend, have in a bank, etc. 生（利）；获（利）

ex.s: This nice Cantonese restaurant in Columbia Heights quickly became a destination for chef Henji Cheung’s Hong Kong-style cooking and co-owner Sarah Thompson’s natural wine list that earned her a Michelin nod.
ex.t: 这家位于Columbia Heights的精致粤菜馆，很快成为主厨Henji Cheung的港式料理以及联合老板Sarah Thompson获得米其林认可的天然葡萄酒单的打卡地。

ex.s: Jennifer Mauer has needed more willpower than the typical college student to pursue her goal of earning a nursing degree.
ex.t: Jennifer Mauer比典型的大学生更需要意志力来追求她获得护理学位的目标。

ex.s: In my ninth-grade writing class last year, I met a cowboy who saved his town, a strict father who demanded his son earn straight A’s, and a modern-day Juliet who died of heartbreak after her parents rejected the love of her young life.
ex.t: 去年在我九年级的写作课上，我遇到了一个拯救了小镇的牛仔、一个要求儿子门门得A的严厉父亲，以及一个在现代版朱丽叶——她在父母拒绝了她年轻生命中的挚爱后，因心碎而死。

ex.s: If it is not turned in by the 4th day after the due date, it will earn a zero.
ex.t: 如果在到期日之后的第4天之前尚未交接，则将获得零分。

ex.s: To earn profits for the crews.
ex.t: 为全体员工赚取利润。

ex.s: That willpower bore fruit when Jennifer graduated from University of Wisconsin-Eau Claire and became the first in her large family to earn a bachelor’s degree.
ex.t: 当詹妮弗从威斯康星大学欧克莱尔分校毕业、成为这个大家庭里第一个获得学士学位的人时，那份意志力结出了果实。

ex.t: 在老师安妮·沙利文的帮助下，她克服了残疾，继续深造并获得文学学士学位。

ex.s: However, her children have learned an important lesson witnessing their mother earn her degree.
ex.t: 然而，她的孩子们目睹母亲获得学位，学到了重要的一课。

defs.def: to get sth that you deserve, usually because of sth good you have done or because of the good qualities you have 应得；博得；赢得

ex.s: Zac knows the meaning of a Purple Heart-he earned one himself in a war as a soldier.
ex.t: 扎克懂得紫心勋章的意义——他作为一名士兵在战争中自己赢得了一枚。

ex.s: To earn himself a good reputation.
ex.t: 为了给自己赢得好名声。

ex.s: It also earned Carson a posthumous Presidential Medal of Freedom and put her face on the 17-cent US stamp.
ex.t: 这也为卡森赢得了后继的总统自由勋章，并将她的脸贴在美国17美分邮票上。

defs.def: to do useful or helpful things in return for being allowed to live or stay somewhere 挣口饭吃；为有栖身之处而工作

ex.s: He wants to help them earn a living.
ex.t: 他认为人能把工作做得更好。

ex.s: It can also be used to reinforce the meanings of themes: in the title The Importance of Being Earnest, “Earnest” is an adjective as well as a character’s name.
ex.t: 也可以用来强化主题的含义：在标题 " 成为收入者的重要性 " 中, " Earnest " 是形容词和人物的名字。

ex.s: You have a job, earned your degree, and you got out of bed today.
ex.t: 你有工作，拿到了学位，而且今天你起了床。

ex.s: Jennifer received great support from her family as she worked to earn her degree: Her husband worked two jobs to cover the bills, and her 68-year-old mother helped take care of the children at times.
ex.t: 珍妮弗在努力攻读学位的过程中得到了家人的大力支持：她的丈夫打两份工来支付账单她68岁的母亲有时帮忙照看孩子。

defs.def: to be worth the amount of time or money that is being spent 值得所花的时间（或金钱）

ex.s: I was so happy that I had earned my service hours in this way.
ex.t: 我很高兴能以这种方式获得我的服务时间。
